rules.statement: The execution sale did not convey the mortgage debt, and the right to recover the mortgaged debt passed only to the original mortgagee's heirs.
rules.supporting_quote: "There was a previous action (C. R., 1,993)about this land. The present plaintiff's vendor sued the purchasers at the Fiscal's sale to be put in possession; he was held to have title, the purchasers at the Fiscal's sale against Salaman being held to have kept the mortgage alive. It may seem hard that the purchasers under writ should fail to prove title, it being held that they had possessed as mortgagees (see C. R., 1,993), and that now they should fail to get the mortgage debt paid to them as they had not purchased the mortgage. But I think the law is clear, and the Fiscal's sale did not convey the mortgage debt."
